skill_name: Research and explain the difference between consumerism and consumer culture.
workflow: Consumerism is the process of acquiring goods and services for personal use, usually through commercial ventures. Consumer culture is a type of culture in which consumerism has a high level of influence and significances, shaping the lifestyles and values of individuals. It is characterized by the belief that acquiring and consuming products and services is a desirable, positive activity.
